enabled_groups.description: QQ groups where automatic join verification is enabled
enabled_groups.hint: Only requests for these groups are processed.

verifier_base_url.hint: Required. Configure this privately in AstrBot; do not commit the endpoint to the repository.

verifier_password.hint: Stored only in AstrBot data/config; never commit credentials into the plugin repository.

dry_run.description: Initial bootstrap mode only; runtime approval is controlled by /njuverify enable|disable
dry_run.hint: Only used to initialize runtime state on first launch. After that, /njuverify status is authoritative.

retry_backoff_seconds.description: Retry delay for transient verification failures

min_verify_interval_seconds.description: Minimum delay between verification service requests

llm_fallback_enabled.description: Use an AstrBot LLM provider only when deterministic answer parsing is insufficient
llm_fallback_enabled.hint: The student ID and QQ number are never sent to the LLM; only the non-ID answer fragment is sent.

llm_fallback_provider_id.description: AstrBot chat provider used for fallback name-boundary extraction

llm_fallback_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for one LLM fallback call

llm_fallback_max_tokens.description: Completion-token budget for the fallback model
llm_fallback_max_tokens.hint: DeepSeek V4 may spend part of this budget on reasoning before emitting the name.
